title: Income Annuities Beneficiary Limits: Number of Primaries, Share Size and Minor Age
content:
Beneficiary designations on Income Annuities contracts work within three figures, uniform across the Ashgrove Income Annuity Life Only, Cash Refund, 10-Year Certain, 20-Year Certain, Joint 50% Survivor and Joint 100% Survivor tiers.

| Figure | Every tier |
|---|---|
| Maximum number of primary beneficiaries | 10 |
| Smallest beneficiary share | 1% (a whole percent) |
| Age below which a share is paid only to a guardian or UTMA custodian | 18 |

**Hypothetical checks.** A designation naming 10 primaries is within the maximum; one naming 11 is not. A share of 1% meets the smallest share; a share of half a percent is not a whole percent of at least 1. A beneficiary aged 17 is below the minor beneficiary age of 18; a beneficiary aged 18 is not.
